title: MartinezPeon2024: Kinesthetic motor imagery at graded force levels
description: EEG recordings of kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at three graded force levels (10%, 40% and 70% of maximal voluntary contraction) from 10 healthy participants. Data were acquired with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC headset at 128 Hz, with five cued imagery trials per 40 s recording. The dataset supports characterization and classification of motor imagery force levels for brain-computer interface research. The associated paper (Martinez-Peon, Garcia-Hernandez, Benavides-Bravo & Parra-Vega, 2024, J. Neural Eng.) lists additional co-authors beyond the BIDS-recorded investigator.
methods_description: Participants performed cue-based kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at 10, 40 and 70% MVC. Each 40 s recording contained five 5 s cues, and each force level was recorded twice per subject across 6 runs. EEG was recorded with a wet saline-electrode Emotiv EPOC (14 channels, 128 Hz, P3/P4 reference).
